decls.name: IsFrobeniusAtPrime
decls.rationale: `IsFrobeniusAtPrime σ P` formalizes the Frobenius element at a prime `P | p`: it acts on the residue field by \(x \mapsto x^{|\mathcal{O}_K/\mathfrak{p}|}\).

decls.name: IsFrobeniusAt
